# Data and analytics

## Scope

Applies when the change touches pipelines, warehouses, schemas, ML data. Not when the change touches one service's own tables with no schema, contract, or pipeline change. Neighbours: `aidd-team:schema-migration`, `aidd-team:privacy-by-default`, `aidd-team:performance`.

## Standards

| # | Standard | Edition | Checked | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | ISO/IEC 25012 data quality model | ISO/IEC 25012:2008 | 2026-10-16 | <https://webstore.iec.ch/en/publication/11246> |
| S2 | Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) (emerging) | v3.2.0 | 2026-10-16 | <https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard/releases> |
| S3 | Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) (emerging) | v1.1.0 | 2026-10-16 | <https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-product-standard/releases> |
| S4 | OpenLineage | 1.53.0 | 2026-10-16 | <https://github.com/OpenLineage/OpenLineage/releases> |
| S5 | Analytics engineering: tests on every model, contracts on published models, and one definition of each metric in a semantic layer | — | 2026-10-16 (reviewed) | <https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/collaborate/publish/model-contracts> |
| S6 | Streaming semantics stated against the transport's own guarantee: idempotent producers and transactions where Kafka carries the data | — | 2026-10-16 | <https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#semantics> |
| S7 | PostgreSQL full text search | PostgreSQL 18 | 2026-10-17 | <https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/textsearch-intro.html> |
| S8 | Reproducible runs: experiment and model-registry tracking, datasets versioned, and every eval run pinned to a model and data snapshot | — | 2026-10-16 (reviewed) | <https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/> |
| S9 | Data and model drift monitored in production, with eval-score and cost signals wired to the rollback trigger | — | 2026-10-16 (reviewed) | <https://research.google/pubs/pub46555/> |
| S10 | Model cards and CycloneDX ML-BOM for models and datasets | CycloneDX 1.7.2 | 2026-10-16 | <https://cyclonedx.org/capabilities/mlbom/> |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before the first edit (`aidd gate --paths`) | A schema, contract, or pipeline change names its producers and consumers; a migration is major (`baseline:migrations`). | S2 |
| Specify | The data contract change (ODCS) is written before Spec approval and listed in `design.files`; quality rules (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness) as tests. | S2, S1 |
| Specify | A shared data product has an ODPS descriptor: an owner and an ODCS contract per output port. | S3, S2 |
| Specify | Search: the database's own full-text search first (PostgreSQL `tsvector` with a GIN index), a search engine only for a measured need. The index follows the data by outbox or change data capture, per-tenant queries filter by tenant, and judged queries prove relevance. | S7 |
| Specify | Training data is a pinned, versioned snapshot, and each run and eval records its model and data snapshot in the model registry. A model and its datasets get a model card and a CycloneDX ML-BOM entry (`aidd-team:ai-features`). | S8, S10 |
| Implement | Idempotent, restartable jobs, with the delivery guarantee stated against the transport's own; lineage emitted (OpenLineage); no personal data in fixtures or logs. | S6, S4 |
| Implement | Warehouse personal data is classified in the contract and masked by column; each reader role sees only the columns it needs. | S2 |
| Review | Lineage names each consumer of a changed field; a breaking contract change waits for them or keeps the old version to a stated date. | S4, S2 |
| Roll out | Row counts, freshness, and null rates are the observe signals; consumers are notified. For a model, input, prediction, and outcome drift too, wired to the rollback trigger. | S1, S9 |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Contract validation (emerging) | producers and consumers pass the contract | `uvx --from datacontract-cli==1.2.2 datacontract test datacontract.yaml` in CI | S2 |
| Data product descriptor check (emerging) | the ODPS descriptor validates | `uvx check-jsonschema==0.38.2` with the ODPS v1.1.0 schema | S3 |
| Data quality tests | the quality rules hold on the output | dbt tests (`dbt test`, dbt-core 1.12.6), Great Expectations (1.23.2), or Soda checks | S1, S5 |
| Lineage check | the changed job emits lineage | an OpenLineage test backend | S4 |

- From `aidd-team:schema-migration`: Migration up and down.
- From `aidd-team:privacy-by-default`: Masked test data check.

## Owned elsewhere

- The migration plan, the backfill, and the rollback: `aidd-team:schema-migration`.
- Query plans for new queries and indexes: `aidd-team:performance`.
- Retention, deletion, and cross-border transfers of personal data: `aidd-team:privacy-by-default`.

## Keep it current

Each entry is due after its `review_every_days` (else emerging 90 days, established 365) or by its `review_due`. An emerging one applies only when the change needs it, said in the Spec. One `aidd eval standards` lists as due is looked up in Specify, and a missing one is proposed to aidd's `schemas/industry-standards.json`.
